title: Fahrenheit to Celsius
description: Read an integer temperature in Fahrenheit and print the equivalent Celsius value rounded to one decimal place, using the formula C = (F - 32) * 5 / 9. Console input arrives as text and must be converted to a number before arithmetic, and the division must stay a float division: truncating to an integer gives the wrong tenth digit. This problem establishes the C1 base skill of variables, type conversion, operators, and console I/O.
output_format: A single number: the Celsius equivalent with exactly one decimal place.
